problem: E18 closed the tie-break exploration arc, but the Experience Layer as a whole (E1..E18) had not yet had a dedicated operational-stability audit covering every real connection, every reused mechanism's reproducibility, and full safety, in one pass.

decision.decision_summary: Audited canonical state (19 Experiences, 2 Patterns, 9 Candidates, 1 locked Policy), re-verified operational reproducibility (Currency Guard, Pattern Registry, candidate dedup/novelty, E14 ranking regression) and operational safety (dangling/duplicate/false-link, no chained auto-execution, PB/Goal/Gap/LPM unmodified) against current real data. All clean: true. Declaring Experience Layer V1 operational_stable=true.

action.action_summary: Read-only audit; reused currencyGuard (E11), prioritizeCandidate (E13), computeGoalTrackRecord/applyTrackRecordTieBreaker (E14), and E12's false-pattern validation logic verbatim. No new mechanism, no code execution.

result.note: Confirms the Experience Layer's own operational stability; does not change this Goal's own real status. No tie-break attempted, no code executed beyond read-only verification.

cause.root_cause_summary: A multi-phase self-improvement arc (E12..E18) had never been audited end-to-end in a single pass for reproducibility and safety before declaring it stable.

lesson: A long chain of individually-honest phases (each fully verified in isolation) still benefits from one final, dedicated end-to-end audit before being declared operationally stable -- it is the difference between "every step was checked" and "the whole system was checked".
